old_route_audit: The Hadamard chamber identities are correct, but pointwise coercivity in the sole hard chamber is false.
new_result: The exact ray (158T,59T;134T,133T) lies on the equal-biquadrate zero cone in the hard chamber. Perturbing one coordinate gives |s| asymptotic T^3, |u| asymptotic T and |v| asymptotic T^2, disproving uniform |u|=O(|s|^(1/4)) and |v|=O(|s|^(1/2)).
new_direction: Replace pointwise shifted bounds by an averaged signature estimate over the quartic difference set, split into a zero-cone tube and a transverse determinant-method region.
remaining_gap: No averaged fibre bound is proved, so no official exponent improves.
